pack: Example cast: John, Susan, Michael, Pepper

people.name: John
people.marker: a battered canvas messenger bag, square dark-framed glasses, and a small notebook that is usually tucked under one arm or left open nearby
people.looks: Man in his early thirties with short dark brown hair, a narrow face, light stubble and an alert expression. Average height and lean build. His posture is slightly folded when concentrating and much more animated when explaining an idea
people.wears: Soft checked overshirts over plain T-shirts, dark jeans and well-used trainers. Practical everyday clothes with muted colours rather than anything formal or fashionable
people.manner: Curious, thoughtful and easily absorbed in whatever is happening. Often notices small technical details before the bigger social picture, then becomes enthusiastic once he has worked out what is going on
people.likes: old computers, maps, puzzle games, repairing small objects and collecting oddly specific facts
people.avoid: formal suits, branded clothing, superhero costumes

people.name: Susan
people.marker: a bright reusable shopping bag, silver hoop earrings and a ceramic travel mug that seems to follow her from room to room
people.looks: Woman in her late thirties with shoulder-length auburn hair, freckles and an expressive round face. Medium height and ordinary build, with open body language and quick facial reactions
people.wears: Straight-leg jeans, comfortable ankle boots, colourful knitted jumpers and simple jackets. Her clothes are practical but usually contain one strong colour or pattern
people.manner: Warm, decisive and dryly funny. Tends to take charge of practical problems without making a ceremony of it, and reacts to nonsense with a very visible raised eyebrow
people.likes: gardening, mystery novels, cooking for friends, second-hand shops and organising trips

people.name: Michael
people.marker: rolled-up sleeves, a scratched wristwatch and hands that are usually occupied with keys, a screwdriver, a folded receipt or whatever object currently needs sorting out
people.looks: Tall man in his mid forties with close-cropped black hair, a broad face and an easy smile. Solid build, relaxed stance, and a habit of leaning against doorframes while listening
people.wears: Plain work shirts or henleys with the sleeves pushed up, charcoal trousers or jeans and sturdy brown shoes. Everything looks chosen to survive being used rather than to make a statement
people.manner: Patient, practical and quietly funny. Usually lets everyone else finish talking before offering the simple solution, then pretends not to notice when it works
people.likes: woodworking, local history, strong coffee, fixing household things and terrible puns
people.avoid: military gear, luxury accessories, flashy logos

people.name: Pepper
people.marker: a small white patch under the chin, one white front paw and a long charcoal tail that curls at the tip
people.looks: Short-haired charcoal-grey cat with yellow-green eyes, a compact body and slightly oversized ears
people.manner: Confident when nobody is paying attention and deeply offended when caught doing something ridiculous. Usually observes from furniture, doorways or inconveniently central patches of floor
people.likes: sunny windows, cardboard boxes, unattended chairs and investigating bags
